# Pause

> Pause is a free iPhone app and website blocker designed to make self-imposed limits harder to undo impulsively.

## The five blocking methods
- Pause: block an App List immediately for a chosen duration.
- Schedule: block an App List automatically between set times on set days.
- Time Limit: allow a set number of minutes per day, then block the App List.
- Open Limit: allow a set number of opens per day.
- Friction Lock: require one or more challenges before a protected app opens.

An App List is a group of selected apps and supported websites. Pause requires no account, shows no ads, and is free right now.
